interface.signature: def isScramble(S1: str, S2: str) -> bool:

preconditions.description: Both inputs S1 and S2 must be strings.
The lengths of S1 and S2 must be equal.
The length of the strings must be between 0 and 31 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in S1) and all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in S2)
preconditions.description: Both strings must consist only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The function returns True if and only if S2 can be obtained from S1 by recursively partitioning S1 into two non-empty substrings and optionally swapping the children at any non-leaf node in the resulting binary tree structure; otherwise it returns False.
